s3-c01.search_scope: Exact weighted polynomial matching against finite Cartan A, B, C, D, E, F, G and tadpole tensor pairs, and the commuting Cartan construction. The RSG and SG constructors previously checked have identity symmetrizer. An unmatched record is not asserted to be new; folded identifications have not been exhausted. Equitable folds and their Langlands duals of the named SG/RSG identity representatives through rank six were also checked after their recorded Cartan-like centering. One witness per parent and dual choice is retained; this bounded parent library does not exhaust all possible unfoldings.
s3-c01.parameter_convention: Cartan names and valuations follow Sage CartanMatrix. Source-to-record transformations retain D; Langlands duals are not identified automatically.
